meta.keys: grid square ids from grid.geojson (farmland squares only)
meta.low_typical_high: 10th, 50th and 90th percentile of the 250 m SoilGrids pixels in the square (its rain-fed arable land where possible)

soilgrids.name: SoilGrids 2.0 (ISRIC), 250 m soil property predictions
soilgrids.cite: Poggio, L. et al. (2021). SoilGrids 2.0. SOIL 7: 217-240. doi:10.5194/soil-7-217-2021

soilgrids_water.name: SoilGrids 2.0 volumetric water content at 33 and 1500 kPa
soilgrids_water.cite: Turek, M. E. et al. (2023). International Soil and Water Conservation Research 11(2): 225-239

meta.ai_assistance: Produced by notebooks written with AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic) and run by the Field Shift team in Google Colab with Google Earth Engine. Data values come from the cited datasets and were not written by the AI, except a few published values from the trial at the demo field (its station's rain and temperature, and its soil description), which were copied by hand from Denora et al. (2025) and are labelled as such.
